name: Muthoot Finance Ltd
about: Muthoot Finance is NBFC engaged in the business of providing gold loans. The company predominately operates in Southern India[1]
keyPoints: Business Verticals 1) Muthoot Finance Ltd (MFL): The company is India’s largest gold financing company in terms of loan portfolio, and also offers Money Transfer Services, Business loans, Corporate Loans, loans against Property, Collection Services, etc. It operates 4,800+ branches across 29 States and Union territories. It holds 202 tons of gold jewelry as security and services 2+ lakh customers daily. [1]
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has delivered good profit growth of 22.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 17.7%
Company's median sales growth is 19.7% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 2.56 times its book value
